changeSet.author: yakushev
changeSet.sql: create table data.futures_position ( id bigserial not null, id_symbol_futures int4 not null constraint fk_fut_pos_symbol_futures references data.symbol_futures(id), side varchar(8) not null, size numeric null, avg_price numeric null, mark_price numeric null, liq_price numeric null, position_value numeric null, leverage numeric(10,2) null, position_idx int4 null, unrealised_pnl numeric null, cur_realised_pnl numeric null, cum_realised_pnl numeric null, take_profit numeric null, stop_loss numeric null, ts_db timestamp default localtimestamp not null, constraint futures_position_pkey primary key (id), constraint ch_futures_position_side check (side in ('Buy', 'Sell')) ); create index idx_futures_position_ts on data.futures_position (ts_db desc); create index idx_futures_position_symbol_ts on data.futures_position (id_symbol_futures, ts_db desc); comment on table data.futures_position is 'Append-only snapshots of open futures positions (one row per poll and position).'; comment on column data.futures_position.ts_db is 'When the snapshot was saved';
changeSet.comment: Create append-only snapshots of open futures positions

changeSet.author: yakushev
changeSet.sql: create table data.futures_position_closed ( id bigserial not null, id_symbol_futures int4 not null constraint fk_fut_pos_closed_symbol_futures references data.symbol_futures(id), side varchar(8) not null, order_id varchar(64) null, order_price numeric null, order_type varchar(32) null, exec_type varchar(32) null, closed_size numeric null, cum_entry_value numeric null, avg_entry_price numeric null, cum_exit_value numeric null, avg_exit_price numeric null, closed_pnl numeric null, leverage numeric(10,2) null, created_time int8 null, updated_time int8 null, ts_db timestamp default localtimestamp not null, constraint futures_position_closed_pkey primary key (id), constraint uk_futures_position_closed unique (id_symbol_futures, order_id, updated_time), constraint ch_futures_position_closed_side check (side in ('Buy', 'Sell')) ); create index idx_futures_position_closed_updated on data.futures_position_closed (updated_time desc); comment on table data.futures_position_closed is 'Closed position records taken from Bybit /v5/position/closed-pnl, stored as returned.'; comment on column data.futures_position_closed.created_time is 'Bybit createdTime (epoch millis)'; comment on column data.futures_position_closed.updated_time is 'Bybit updatedTime (epoch millis)'; comment on column data.futures_position_closed.ts_db is 'When the record was saved';

changeSet.author: yakushev
changeSet.sql: create table data.futures_positions_config ( id int4 not null, open_poll_secs int4 not null, closed_poll_secs int4 not null, closed_lookback_min int4 not null, is_enabled bool default true not null, constraint futures_positions_config_pkey primary key (id), constraint ch_futures_positions_config_id check (id = 1), constraint ch_futures_positions_config_open_poll check (open_poll_secs > 0), constraint ch_futures_positions_config_closed_poll check (closed_poll_secs > 0), constraint ch_futures_positions_config_lookback check (closed_lookback_min > 0) ); comment on table data.futures_positions_config is 'Single-row online configuration of the futures positions collector.'; comment on column data.futures_positions_config.closed_lookback_min is 'How far back each closed-pnl poll looks, in minutes';

changeSet.author: yakushev
changeSet.sql: insert into data.futures_positions_config(id, open_poll_secs, closed_poll_secs, closed_lookback_min, is_enabled) values (1, 60, 60, 120, true);
